subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for KiteBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@kitebank.com>, Laura Perez <laura.perez@kitebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for KiteBank

Hi Samir and Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time today \u00151 great conversation and appreciate the context on your risk workflows. As promised, attached is a short POC outline (redwood_poc_outline.pdf) and a term sheet for the proposed evaluation window (redwood_sla_term_sheet.pdf).

Recap from the demo (high level):
- Inference features: streaming chat, function/tool calling for transaction lookups, and embeddings for contextual retrieval.
- Typical throughput we showed: 120 reqs/min with p95 latency ~300ms on a dedicated slot similar to your anticipated workload.
- Security: VPC/private deployment and KMS integrations discussed; will run security checklist during procurement.

Proposed POC / Evaluation plan (summary):
1) Success criteria (please confirm):
   - Accuracy: <= 10% false positive rate on fraud detection assistant responses measured on a 200-case test set you provide.
   - Latency: p95 response time <= 400ms for typical 256-token prompts under expected concurrency.
   - Stability: zero critical errors and <0.5% error rate over a 2-week sustained run.
   - Integration: ability to call internal lookup API via function calling and resolve 95% of referenced transactions.
2) Timeline: 2-week setup + 2-week evaluation run (4 weeks total). Kickoff week of Apr 26 (flexible).
3) Owners:
   - KiteBank: Samir (technical lead), Laura (product owner)
   - Redwood: Marissa (sales/POC lead), Dylan (solutions engineer)
4) Data/Access needed: access to a sanitized sample dataset (200 labeled cases), API endpoint for transaction lookup (staging), and security questionnaire answers.
5) Next steps (please confirm by EOD Wed):
   - Confirm success criteria and timeline.
   - Share contact for procurement/security and any required contract redlines.
   - Confirm kickoff availability (proposed: Wed Apr 28 10am PT or Thu Apr 29 11am PT).

Attachment: redwood_poc_outline.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: redwood_sla_term_sheet.pdf (application/pdf)

Looking forward to your thoughts \u00151 happy to adjust criteria if you want to prioritize a different metric.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
From: Samir Gupta <samir@kitebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Perez <laura.perez@kitebank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for KiteBank

Marissa \u00151 thanks for the recap and the deck. Quick notes from our side after syncing with Product and Security:

- Success criteria: the accuracy target looks good, but can we make the latency requirement a bit more explicit around 95th percentile for both retrieval+LLM combined? For our stack that matters.
- Security: Laura flagged that we need an initial checklist (SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details). Can your security team fill the standard questionnaire?
- Procurement: we typically require a 30-day review window for T&Cs; procurement will want to see the SLA term sheet.

On timing \u00151 we can do the kickoff the week of Apr 26 but prefer Thu Apr 29 11am PT if that still works for your team.

Samir \u00151 appreciate the quick response and the procurement heads-up. We can adjust the latency success criterion to explicitly call out end-to-end p95 (retrieval + LLM) <= 450ms to give a little buffer; let me know if 450ms is acceptable or if you prefer 400ms.

Security: Dylan (cc'd) will own the initial questionnaire and can drop the SOC 2 / encryption-at-rest notes this week. Dylan \u00151 I'll DM you the security contact at KiteBank and the questionnaire link.

Updated success criteria (proposed):
- Accuracy: <= 10% FP on the provided 200-case test set.
- End-to-end latency: p95 <= 450ms (retrieval + LLM).
- Stability: <0.5% error rate over a 2-week sustained run.
- Integration: 95% successful transaction resolutions via function calling.

Kickoff: Thu Apr 29 11:00 AM PT \u00151 confirmed for Redwood. If that works for KiteBank we will send a calendar invite and a short kickoff agenda (30-45m).

Attachment: redwood_poc_outline.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks \u00151 Marissa
